name: AWS General Hunt!!
author: SOC Team Alpha
prerequisites: AWS CloudTrail enabled in all regions
required_tools: Splunk with CloudTrail Add-on or AWS Athena

hunt_actions.title: Credential Abuse Detection
actions: List IAM users with console access but no MFA: `aws iam generate-credential-report && aws iam get-credential-report | python3 -c 'import sys,base64,csv; r=csv.DictReader(base64.b64decode(sys.stdin.read()).decode().splitlines()); [print(row) for row in r if row["password_enabled"]=="true" and row["mfa_active"]=="false"]'`

Query CloudTrail for API calls from unusual regions: In Athena run `SELECT useridentity.arn, awsregion, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE awsregion NOT IN ('us-east-1','us-west-2') AND eventtime > '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 50;`

Detect root account usage: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=root --start-time $(date -d '90 days ago' +%s) --query 'Events[*].{Time:EventTime,Event:EventName,IP:CloudTrailEvent}' --output table`

Hunt AssumeRole chains: Search CloudTrail for eventName=AssumeRole where requestParameters.roleArn differs from useridentity.sessioncontext.sessionissuer.arn across consecutive events within a 5-minute window. Splunk SPL: `index=cloudtrail eventName=AssumeRole | transaction useridentity.principalId maxspan=5m | where mvcount(requestParameters.roleArn) > 3`

hunt_actions.title: Data Exfiltration Indicators
actions: Find S3 buckets with public ACLs created in the last 30 days: `aws s3api list-buckets --query 'Buckets[?CreationDate>=`2025-03-01`].[Name]' --output text | xargs -I{} aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket {} 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'AllUsers\|AuthenticatedUsers'`

Detect large S3 GetObject by non-service accounts: CloudTrail Athena query: `SELECT useridentity.arn, requestparameters, SUM(CAST(additionaleventdata.bytestransferred AS BIGINT)) as total_bytes FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE eventname='GetObject' AND eventtime > '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING total_bytes > 1073741824 ORDER BY total_bytes DESC;`
Review Glacier vault policy changes: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=SetVaultAccessPolicy --output table`

Audit cross-account data sharing: `aws s3api list-buckets --output text --query 'Buckets[].Name' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo {}; aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket {} 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool | grep -i "AWS":' 2>/dev/null`

hunt_actions.title: Persistence Mechanisms
actions: Hunt for IAM users or access keys created in last 7 days: `aws iam list-users --query 'Users[?CreateDate>=`2025-03-24`].[UserName,CreateDate,UserId]' --output table` and `aws iam list-access-keys --query 'AccessKeyMetadata[?CreateDate>=`2025-03-24`]'`

Detect Lambda functions created outside CI/CD: `aws lambda list-functions --query 'Functions[?LastModified>=`2025-01-01`].[FunctionName,LastModified,Role]' --output table` then cross-reference with approved deployment pipeline IAM roles.

Review CloudFormation stacks for unauthorized resources: `aws cloudformation describe-stacks --query 'Stacks[*].[StackName,StackStatus,CreationTime,LastUpdatedTime]' --output table` then `aws cloudformation list-stack-resources --stack-name <StackName>` for any unfamiliar stack.

questions: Is AWS CloudTrail enabled and logging to S3 in ALL regions, including the global services region (us-east-1)?
Are CloudTrail S3 bucket logs protected by MFA-delete and versioning to prevent tampering?
Is AWS GuardDuty enabled in every active account and region within the organization?
What is the configured CloudTrail log retention period, and does it meet the organization's minimum retention policy (e.g., 1 year)?
Are there any IAM users or roles assigned the AWS managed AdministratorAccess policy, and are they justified and documented?
Is there a formal approval process for cross-account IAM role trust relationships, and is that list reviewed quarterly?
Which SIEM or log aggregation platform ingests CloudTrail logs, and what is the average ingest latency?
Are AWS Config rules deployed to enforce compliance baselines (e.g., MFA on root, no public S3 buckets), and are non-compliant findings remediated automatically or manually?
